cells.gaps: The bureau certified the e-Government Authority to ISO 27001:2022 in January 2026 (TZA-006), but no source says that standard is adopted as a Tanzania Standard; its draft adoptions of 2025 do not include it. No certification against the accessibility standard or another national standard on information technology or data is held.
cells.note: The Tanzania Bureau of Standards, set up under the Standards Act (TZA-003, TZA-001), has introduced a national ICT accessibility standard (TZA-002, TZA-005). Its January 2026 certificate to the e-Government Authority (TZA-006) is against an international standard not shown to be national, so stages 4 and 5 are not met.
